pois.name: Cologne Zoological Garden
pois.blurb: Cologne Zoological Garden is a zoo in Cologne, Germany. Founded in 1860, it is one of the oldest zoological gardens in the country and remains open to the public.

themeConnection.text: Founded in 1860 and still operating as a public zoological garden in Cologne.

pois.name: Korkeasaari Zoo
pois.blurb: Korkeasaari Zoo (Finnish: Korkeasaaren eläintarha), also known as Helsinki Zoo, is the largest zoo in Finland, located in Helsinki's Korkeasaari island.

image.attribution: Annika Sorjonen / Korkeasaari Zoo · CC BY-SA 4.0

themeConnection.text: Opened to the public in 1889 on Korkeasaari Island and continues as Helsinki's public zoo.

pois.name: Wrocław Zoo
pois.blurb: Wrocław Zoo is a zoological garden in Wrocław, Poland. It was opened in 1865 and is the oldest zoo in Poland, continuing to operate as a public animal collection.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1865 and continues as a public zoo at its site in Wrocław.

pois.name: Zoo Basel
pois.blurb: Zoo Basel is a non-profit zoo in Basel, Switzerland. It opened in 1874 and is the oldest zoo in Switzerland, continuing to receive regular public visitors at its original urban site.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1874 and continues operating as a public zoo at its Basel site.

pois.name: ARTIS
pois.blurb: Natura Artis Magistra (Latin for "Nature is the teacher of art"), commonly known just as Artis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɑrtɪs]), is a zoo and botanical garden in the centre of Amsterdam.

image.attribution: The original uploader was Mtcv at Dutch Wikipedia. · CC BY-SA 3.0

themeConnection.text: Established in 1838 as Natura Artis Magistra and still operates as a public zoo at the site.

pois.name: Moscow Zoo
pois.blurb: Moscow Zoo is one of the oldest zoos in Europe. It was founded in 1864 and is located in central Moscow, where it continues to exhibit living animals to ordinary visitors.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1864 and remains an operating public zoo on its historic Moscow site.

pois.name: Tiergarten Schönbrunn
pois.blurb: Tiergarten Schönbrunn, also known as the Vienna Zoo, is located in the grounds of Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna. Founded in 1752, it is the world's oldest continuously operating zoo.

themeConnection.text: Founded as an imperial menagerie in 1752 and still operating as a public zoo at Schönbrunn.

pois.name: Zoologischer Garten Berlin
pois.blurb: The Berlin Zoological Garden is the oldest surviving zoo in Germany and opened on 1 August 1844. It occupies a large site in Berlin and remains one of the city's principal public attractions.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1844 at its current Zoological Garden site and continues as a public zoo.

pois.name: Alipore Zoological Gardens
pois.blurb: Alipore Zoological Gardens, also called Alipore Zoo, is India's oldest formally stated zoological park. It opened to the public in 1876 and remains a public zoo in Kolkata.

themeConnection.text: Opened to the public in 1876 and remains an operating public zoo in Kolkata.

pois.name: ZSL London Zoo
pois.blurb: London Zoo is one of the world's oldest scientific zoos. It was opened in 1828 and is located at the northern edge of Regent's Park in London, where it remains a public zoological garden.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1828 in Regent's Park and remains a public zoo at the same identifiable site.

pois.name: Dresden Zoo
pois.blurb: Dresden Zoo is a zoo in Dresden, Germany. It was founded in 1861 and is located in the city's Großer Garten area, where it continues to present living animals to visitors.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1861 and remains an operating public zoo within Dresden.

pois.name: Dublin Zoo
pois.blurb: Dublin Zoo (Irish: Zú Bhaile Átha Cliath), in Phoenix Park, is a zoo in Dublin, Ireland, and one of Dublin's most popular attractions.

image.attribution: Rory Parle (Rparle at English Wikipedia) · CC BY-SA 3.0

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1831 in Phoenix Park and continues operating as a public zoo at that site.

pois.name: Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes
pois.blurb: The Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes (French pronunciation: [menaʒʁi dy ʒaʁdɛ̃ de plɑ̃t]) is a zoo in Paris, France, belonging to the botanical garden Jardin des Plantes.

themeConnection.text: The public menagerie opened in 1794 and remains an operating animal-display institution within Paris.

pois.name: Leningrad Zoo
pois.blurb: Leningrad Zoo, now in Saint Petersburg, was founded in 1865. It is situated in Alexandrovsky Park on Petrogradsky Island and remains a regularly visited public zoo.

themeConnection.text: Founded in 1865 and still operating as a public zoo at its historic Saint Petersburg location.

pois.name: ZOO Antwerpen
pois.blurb: Antwerp Zoo (Dutch: ZOO Antwerpen) is a zoo in the centre of Antwerp, Belgium, located next to the Antwerpen-Centraal railway station.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1843 on its present central Antwerp site and remains a public zoological garden.

pois.name: Copenhagen Zoo
pois.blurb: Copenhagen Zoo is a zoological garden in Copenhagen, Denmark. Founded in 1859, it is one of the oldest zoos in Europe and continues to operate as a public animal-display institution.

themeConnection.text: Founded in 1859 and still operating as a public zoo at Frederiksberg in Copenhagen.

pois.name: Leipzig Zoological Garden
pois.blurb: Leipzig Zoological Garden is a zoo in Leipzig, Germany. It was founded in 1878 and has continued as a public zoological garden at the northern edge of the city.

themeConnection.text: Founded in 1878 and still operates as a public zoo at its Leipzig site.

pois.name: Adelaide Zoo
pois.blurb: Adelaide Zoo is Australia's second-oldest zoo, opened in 1883. It is located just north of Adelaide's city centre and remains a regularly open public zoo with living animals.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1883 and continues operating as a public zoo at its Adelaide site.

pois.name: Melbourne Zoo
pois.blurb: Melbourne Zoo is located in Royal Park, Melbourne, Australia. It was opened in 1862 and is Australia's oldest zoo, continuing to operate as a major public zoological garden.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1862 at Royal Park and remains a public zoo at that Melbourne site.

pois.name: Budapest Zoo and Botanical Garden
pois.blurb: The Budapest Zoo and Botanical Garden is the oldest zoo park in Hungary. It opened in 1866 in Budapest's City Park and remains a public institution displaying living animals.

themeConnection.text: Opened in 1866 at its present City Park site and continues as a public zoo.

clue.text: Born during a revolution, this menagerie received animals from a dissolved royal collection and became part of a national natural-history institution and botanical garden.

theme.title: Operating Zoological Gardens Founded Before 1900
theme.introduction: Generations of city dwellers have met the animal world here. These historic zoos remain living fixtures of their urban landscapes.
theme.inclusionCriteria: Include a location only when every condition is met: (1) it is an individually named zoo, zoological garden, zoological park, menagerie, or equivalent institution whose principal function is the public display of living non-domesticated animals; (2) the institution was established or opened at the same identifiable site on or before 31 December 1899; (3) it still operates at that site as a permanent animal-display institution on the date of play; (4) it provides regularly scheduled public admission, whether ticketed or free; (5) the site lies within the current administrative boundary of a present-day city or incorporated urban municipality; and (6) the named zoo can be pinned as one exact visitable map location.
